decoded.meaning: SUBSCRIBER{ PATH{ NAME "client" }, SETTINGS{ NAME "delivery_policy" VALUE u16=0xFFC1 } } — every reserved bit (6–15) set: MUST be ignored, never rejected; reliability=1 below them still applies (RFC-0022 §5.3)
decoded.note: an implementation that rejects unknown bits fails this vector; so does one that lets them leak into reliability or priority
